targets.anomaly-forge: Anomaly Forge hypercharge uniqueness for a declared finite chiral field inventory

claim_boundary: Exact rational cancellation conditions for a declared finite chiral field inventory. Not a statement about arbitrary chiral gauge theories, not a continuum construction, and not a Millennium Prize claim. A node is only 'verified' when lake build succeeds; the checked-in DAG records structure, never verification status.

nodes.description: Gauge-invariant up and down Yukawa terms make the SU(3)^2-U(1) coefficient vanish identically for every colour count.
SU(2)^2-U(1) cancellation is equivalent to the lepton-doublet hypercharge YL = -(n * YQ).
Under the Yukawa relations and YL = -(n * YQ), the gravity^2-U(1) coefficient collapses to YH - n * YQ.
Uniqueness in division-free form: the Yukawa relations plus SU(2)^2 and gravity^2 cancellation force n*YQ = YH, YL = -YH, n*Yu = YH*(n+1), n*Yd = YH*(1-n), Ye = -2*YH.
At the assignment fixed by A04 the U(1)^3 coefficient vanishes for every colour count, so the cubic condition is implied rather than imposed.
The Standard Model point n = 3, YH = 1/2, giving (1/6, 2/3, -1/3, -1/2, -1), is anomaly free.
The audited perturbation Yu = 7/10 is rejected, mirroring run_anomaly_forge.py --y-u 7/10 --require-pass.
With a Dirac right-handed neutrino every YQ is anomaly free: uniqueness fails and a one-parameter family survives. This is the declared boundary on A04 and A13.
The A08 family meets the neutrino-free Standard Model exactly where the right-handed neutrino hypercharge vanishes.
Electric and composite charges at the Standard Model point under Q = T3 + Y: u = 2/3, d = -1/3, e = -1, nu = 0, proton = 1, neutron = 0.
Witten global SU(2) parity: three generations of three colours give twelve left-handed doublets (even), two colours give nine (odd, inadmissible).
The generation factor is a nonzero scalar, so per-generation cancellation decides generation-universal cancellation.
Flagship: the Yukawa relations plus SU(2)^2 and gravity^2 cancellation pin the assignment and leave SU(3)^2 and U(1)^3 cancelling automatically.
The input probabilities partition unity. Coq: input_probability_normalized.
A measured system branch has weight exactly 1/2. Coq: system_zero_probability, which system_one_probability restates verbatim.
The two system branches exhaust the probability; the fact the duplicated Coq pair was reaching for.
Recovery on B returns |alpha|^2 exactly. Coq: recovery_zero_probability.
Recovery on B returns |beta|^2 exactly. Coq: recovery_one_probability.
The recovered probabilities stay normalised. Coq: recovered_probability_normalized, chained the same way.
Not in the Coq source: the measured system statistics are identical for every normalised input, so the system retains no information about alpha and beta.
